mapper.select: SELECT rd.user_id AS userId, rd.record_category AS recordCategory, rd.record_account_id AS recordAccountId, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rd.amount > 0 THEN rd.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN rd.amount < 0 THEN ABS(rd.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpend, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM tb_record_detail rd WHERE rd.record_book_id = #{bookId} AND DATE_FORMAT(rd.occur_time, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth} AND rd.review_status IN (0, 2) AND rd.delete_time IS NULL AND rd.target_account_id IS NULL GROUP BY rd.user_id, rd.record_category, rd.record_account_id
